text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can generate paintings, compose music, and even write stories or poems. Some people are amazed by these creations, while others worry that machines will replace human artists. However, AI does not truly "create" in the human sense. It learns from vast amounts of existing data and combines patterns in new ways. Human creativity, on the other hand, comes from personal experience, emotion, and imagination. So, AI is a useful tool for inspiration or quick drafts, but it cannot copy the deep meaning behind art made by people. In the end, AI may assist us, but human creativity remains unique.
